findings.issue: C780/C781 only require binding interfaces to be 'as specified in 15.4.3.4.2/15.4.3.4.3'; operand-position and defined-assignment effects are owned there.
findings.resolution: Fixtures removed; facets pending with the canonical owners named.

findings.issue: C785 only requires a dummy named arg-name when PASS(arg-name) appears; the passed-object behaviour is 7.5.4.5 p4 and 15.5.2.
C789/C790 positives did not reach the prohibitions (no DEFERRED override; no override of a NON_OVERRIDABLE binding).

lesson: Constraints that say an interface 'shall be as specified in' another section do not own the runtime behaviour of that interface. Credit the behaviour to the section that states it.

integration.note: Binding new facets into the shared 7.5.5 catalogue re-fingerprinted fifteen type_bound fixture reviews; each was renewed at its own original state.
